Decision gate: reproduce on the installed tractable-mcp version. If the recovery hint is no longer misleading, close with the quoted current message. If it is, file it in the tractable project's tracker or issue list; it is not fixed in this repository. Guardrails: reproduce against a throwaway store (for example the sandbox store that tracker.py seeds), never by setting or clearing a hold on a real item in this tracker; do not change the todo skill's guidance in this item; do not upgrade tractable-mcp while any evaluation is running, since an upgrade changes todo-family scenario behaviour, and record its version in the closing note.
